newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500s end down, near day's lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500s end down, near day's lows.

text.p: U.S. December Standard and Poor's 500 futures finished lower, near session lows, after faltering late in the day.
December slid as low as 699.70, below psychologically key 700.00 that had been an upside target earlier in the market's charge into record territory.
Some traders said the selloff was profit-taking before this week's load of economic data. Others said the market was merely correcting from its recent steep move higher.
Traders noted waves of sell stops on the afternoon decline.
